'''Tornay Lanasiet''' is a [[Dragonsworn]] from [[Tarabon]].

== Appearance ==
He is stocky.

== Activities ==
He is part of [[Rodel Ituralde]]'s force that attacked a [[Seanchan]] camp near the village of [[Serana]]. Lanasiet and his men continued to chase the fleeing Seanchan after Ituralde gave the command to halt.
